name: Ajishima Mihiro
source:
Hobbies: Internet, live chatting and streaming
Likes: PCs, gadgets, information gathering
Dislikes: Being offline, 3D

The president of the NETC (Network Communication) club who loves life hacks and all kinds of gadgets. Her motto is "The internet is so vast!". She hands out secret information to the others through her LIVE chat.
